+            continue

+            continue

+
+def sort_key(base, name, opts):

+        lname = name

+        return (-(st.st_mtime if st else 0), lname)

+        except OSError: return ""

+
+def display_name(base, name, opts):

+    return text
+
+
+def perms(path):

+    try:
+        m = os.lstat(path).st_mode
+    except OSError:
+        return k + "?????????"
+    bits = ""
+    for r, w, x in ((stat.S_IRUSR, stat.S_IWUSR, stat.S_IXUSR), (stat.S_IRGRP, stat.S_IWGRP, stat.S_IXGRP), (stat.S_IROTH, stat.S_IWOTH, stat.S_IXOTH)):
+        bits += "r" if m & r else "-"
+        bits += "w" if m & w else "-"
+        bits += "x" if m & x else "-"
+    return k + bits
+
+
+def username(uid):

+
+

+    except Exception: return str(gid)
+
+
+def size_text(path):

+    except OSError: return "-"
+    return str(n)
+
+

+    return f"{t.day:2d} {t:%b} {t.year:5d}"
+

+    if not opts.no_time: parts.append(time_text(path))
+    parts.append(display_name(base, name, opts))
+    return " ".join(parts)
+
+
+def listing(path, opts):

+    else:

+
+
+def recurse(path, opts, first=True, depth=0):
+    if not first:
+        print()
+        print(f"{path}:")
+    listing(path, opts)
+    if opts.level is not None and depth >= opts.level:
+        return
+    for n in visible_entries(path, opts):
+        full = os.path.join(path, n)
+        if n in (".", ".."): continue
+        if os.path.isdir(full) and not os.path.islink(full):
+            recurse(full, opts, False, depth + 1)
+
+
+def tree(path, opts):
+    print(path.replace("/", os.sep))
+    tree_children(path, opts, "", 0)
+
+
+def tree_children(path, opts, prefix, depth):
+    if opts.level is not None and depth >= opts.level:
+        return
+    names = visible_entries(path, opts)
+    for idx, n in enumerate(names):
+        last = idx == len(names) - 1
+        branch = "└── " if last else "├── "
+        full = os.path.join(path, n)
+        line = long_line(path, n, opts) if opts.long else display_name(path, n, opts)
+        print(prefix + branch + line)
+        if n not in (".", "..") and os.path.isdir(full) and not os.path.islink(full):
+            tree_children(full, opts, prefix + ("    " if last else "│   "), depth + 1)
+
+
+def path_error(path, err):
+    sys.stderr.write(f"\x1b[31;1m\"{path}\": {err.strerror or err}\x1b[0m\n")
+
+
+def main(argv):
+    opts = parse(argv)
+    status = 0
+    for idx, path in enumerate(opts.paths):
+        if not os.path.lexists(path):
+            try: open(path, "rb").close()
+            except OSError as e: path_error(path, e)
+            status = 2
+            continue
+        if len(opts.paths) > 1 and os.path.isdir(path):
+            if idx: print()
+            print(f"{path}:")
+        if opts.tree:
+            tree(path, opts)
+        elif opts.recurse and os.path.isdir(path):
+            recurse(path, opts)
+        else:
+            listing(path, opts)
+    return status
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
